text:
sasha: Quick async — running a headroom smoke test in eu-west-1 now. Planning to drain 2 nodes from lane-gpu-03 at 22:30 UTC to validate prewarm/autoscaler behavior. If you have any long-running jobs, please ack and move or pause. link: https://go/runbooks/gpu-drain :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jon: ack — nothing heavy from my side, watching queues. Will ping if any backlog spikes :eyes:
maria: noting that the staging `model-rollout` job spins up ~6 containers but they use dedicated pools, should be safe. Will still watch latency on rerank routes.
sasha: thanks — expected ~10-15% lane throughput drop for ~8 min while KV cache warms back up. Objective is to confirm autoscaler brings prewarm from 1->3 in <60s.
ops-bot: scheduled drain created by @sasha for lane-gpu-03 [nodes: lane-gpu-03a, lane-gpu-03b]. ETA 22:30 UTC. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/gpu-drain
lee: FYI, can we ensure fallback routing to `gpt-medium-quant` if primary capacity dips? quick snippet below I pushed to the routing config.
```
route: 
  - match: /generate
    prefer: [gpt-large, gpt-medium-quant]
    fallback: gpt-medium-quant
    max_latency_ms: 250
```

tim: heads-up — quota dashboards show eu-west-1 spot buffers at 72%. If the drain causes spot reclaim, autoscaler might struggle. Recommend raising spot buffer to 85% for the next 2h.
sasha: good catch, tim. I'll bump the buffer for the smoke window and revert after. Doing `./ops tool set-spot-buffer --region eu-west-1 --pct 85 --ttl 2h` now.
jon: saw a transient 30s spike in the small async-embeddings queue during the last test — if we see similar, we should temporarily route embeddings to dedicated-embed pool.
maria: agreed. If spike > 25% then `embed-route` to dedicated pool. I can flip that if it triggers.
sasha: all set for the run. I'll post a quick follow-up once nodes are back and prewarm times measured. TL;DR: drain @22:30, spot-buffer 85% for 2h, watch embeddings queue, fallback config is in. :white_check_mark:
